content_sections.heading: ACTREC Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ACTREC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ACTREC recruitment is Senior Resident (Pathology). This is a contractual position offered by the Advanced Centre for Treatment Research and Education in Cancer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Senior Resident (Pathology) post in this recruitment drive by ACTREC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Senior Resident (Pathology) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD/DNB (Pathology) or an equivalent PG Degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident (Pathology) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident (Pathology) post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident (Pathology) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being done through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the date of the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Senior Resident (Pathology) position is scheduled to be held on 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ACTREC located?
faq.answer: ACTREC is located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 410210. The specific interview venue details will be available in the official notification.
